indicator_name: Government securities outstanding (incl. NBK short-term notes) by type, end of month
description: Государственные ценные бумаги в обращении (в т.ч. краткосрочные ноты НБК) по видам, на конец месяца
methodology: NBK formId=430, 2010-01 onward (the scalar GOV_SECURITIES_MEUKAM is the MEUKAM row). Dated by report_date, the 1st of the month after the stock date (as GOV_SECURITIES_MEUKAM). NBK_NOTES = short-term NBK notes, an open-market liquidity-absorption instrument (681 021 mln at 2010-02-01, 1 200 000 at 2024-01-01, 1 144 260 at 2026-09-01); 454 129 at 2025-01-01 equals the notes in the NBK's daily open position on 31.12.2024 (NBK_OPEN_POSITION).
